PR04: bind retained inspector callbacks to controller and composition leases

The selection-revision guard alone let a retained callback from an old
snapshot edit a replacement host: the stable command facade re-points to
the new controller after Plate.controller changes, and a plugin
composition commit replaces capabilities under the same controller and
selection without moving the revision. The facade now exposes its current
controller and committed composition generation, and the inspector mapper
captures both at resolve time and rejects callbacks once either moves.

Regressions: retained A binding no-ops after A-controller to B-controller
re-point (A stays alive) and after a plugin A to B composition commit,
asserting document, notifications, and undo/redo history stay unchanged
while fresh snapshots keep working.
